args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+ recommended)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, hat, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel confirmations, flight tickets)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Light rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Flip flops/sandals
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented)
- Insect repellent
- Power adapter/converter if needed
- Medications
- Beach bag

Packing Tips:
- Pack light as laundry services are available at most hotels
- Bring layers for cooler evenings
- Consider the activities planned (hiking, beach days, cultural events)
- Don't forget chargers for electronic devices
